hints.content:
To measure slope, we pick any two points on the line. Then we look at the horizontal and vertical distances between those points.



[[☃ image 1]]

options.alt: A coordinate plane. The x- and y-axes each scale by one. A graph of a line intersects the points negative three, four and one, negative three. There is a horizontal dotted segment from negative three, four to one, four that is labeled four. There is a vertical dotted segment from one, four to one, negative three that is labeled negative seven.

hints.content: The slope of the line is $-\dfrac{7}{4}$.
